sections.heading: Order
paragraphs: PO-TW-624. Vendor Arden Field Instruments. Purchase of 40 temperature probes and 10 spare cables for Rotterdam field stock. Total EUR 2,340.

sections.heading: Approvals
paragraphs: Fleet Operations confirmed the stock forecast. Finance approved the quote on 6 October because the total exceeds the regional budget-owner threshold.

sections.heading: Delivery
paragraphs: Deliver in two lots by 16 October. Fleet Operations will record serial numbers at receipt and hold any damaged items for the vendor to inspect.
